hints.title: Triangular Length Invariant
hints.text: Every valid staircase subarray must have length equal to a triangular number T(k) = k * (k + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Strict Distinct Count Pruning
hints.text: Since max length of any subarray is n, the maximum number of distinct elements k is bounded by sqrt(2 * n).

hints.title: Fast Validation
hints.text: At each triangular offset, check if the distinct frequencies match the exact 1 through k staircase progression.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bounded search since k <= sqrt(2n) for triangular sequence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unconstrained subarray frequency checks take cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(sqrt(n)) auxiliary storage for frequency tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the maximum distinct elements in any valid subarray cannot exceed sqrt(2n).
